name: Jay Rockefeller

offices.t: Secretary of State of West Virginia

summary:
John Davison "Jay" Rockefeller IV (June 18, 1937 – November 6, 2026) was an American politician who served as a United States senator from West Virginia from 1985 to 2015 and previously as governor of West Virginia from 1977 to 1985. He was a member of the Democratic Party.
Born into the prominent Rockefeller family in New York City, Rockefeller moved to Emmons, West Virginia, in 1964 to serve as a Volunteers in Service to America (VISTA) worker.
